name: Mento Kenyan Shilling
oneLiner: KESm is Mento's Kenyan shilling stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing KESm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the KESm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento documents non-USDm/EURm FX stables as USDm-collateralized CDP assets; KESm's complete production oracle and liquidation branch remains unverified.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 oracle review
branchApplicability.rationale: The current Mento documentation identifies the USDm-collateralized CDP and shared oracle/circuit-breaker infrastructure, but the reviewed public sources do not establish the complete production KESm liquidation and failure-handling branch.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Bounded unknown retained: Mento documentation and the verified KESm deployment establish the reserve-backed system, but do not establish a complete holder-level blacklist or freeze inventory for the token and its upstream reserve assets.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: KESm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC. No direct KESm holder-control function is asserted without a deployment-wide verified control inventory.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: KESm is minted CDP-style on Celo via immutable BorrowerOperations; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay) whose sole proposer is the veMENTO DAO Governor.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: KESm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero — immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (KESm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, KESm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() = 172800; hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036...) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577: KESm owner() = Mento Timelock 0x890DB...; getMinDelay() = 172800s; MentoGovernor is sole PROPOSER; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: KESm supply is confined to its canonical Celo deployment; the single reviewed route is native Mento CDP issuance. No bridge route carries the claim.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)

routes.reviewNote: Mento KESm is issued only on Celo through the immutable Mento BorrowerOperations CDP path (mint-authority review 2026-06-11); the entire captured supply is the canonical Celo deployment. No bridge route carries the claim.

reserves.name: CELO
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Celo network native asset held by Mento Reserve governance

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
reserveReview.rationale: The prior single USDm-CDP dependency slice could not classify the live mento adapter rows: KESm's adapter runs in broker-pool mode without a cdpStablecoin parameter, so its captured reserve composition is the shared Mento Reserve basket (identical in shape to BRLm and ZARm), leaving the CELO and stETH exposures unstructured. The envelope is restated on the adapter's exact constituent identities and 2026-07-20 captured weights from the issuer-run reserve analytics API; each stablecoin constituent links to its tracked asset, and CELO and stETH now carry explicit classification and failure-domain identity. The live adapter refreshes weights at runtime, and the direct USDm mint collateral remains documented in the collateral and pegMechanism fields.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API constituent identities and weights captured 2026-07-20; KESm is reserve-backed per Mento's backing registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every constituent of the shared Mento Reserve captured by the live adapter is identified and either linked to a tracked stablecoin or explicitly classified. Constituent weights drift and are refreshed by the live adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserve assets are held in the on-chain Mento Reserve contract under Mento governance rather than with a legal custodian, so legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions are not established by the reviewed sources; constituent-level custody (e.g. Circle, Tether, Lido) sits with each issuer.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: KES is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so KESm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
